# Vivix

> A free, open-source JavaScript execution visualiser that runs entirely in the browser. No install. No account required.

Vivix shows how JavaScript executes step by step — the call stack growing and shrinking frame by frame, heap memory mutating as objects are allocated, and async/await suspending a function mid-execution and reconstructing it after the microtask queue resolves.

Built for developers and educators who need to see beyond what standard debuggers show.

## Modules

- [Variables & Memory](https://vivix.dev/variables)
- [Functions](https://vivix.dev/function)
- [Conditionals](https://vivix.dev/if-gate)
- [For Loops](https://vivix.dev/for-loop)
- [Closures & Scope](https://vivix.dev/closures)
- [Async / Await](https://vivix.dev/async)
- [Promise Methods](https://vivix.dev/promise-chain)
- [DOM Events](https://vivix.dev/event-listeners)
- [Array Methods](https://vivix.dev/array)
- [Objects & Hash Maps](https://vivix.dev/objects)
- [Data Structures](https://vivix.dev/data-structures)
- [HTTP & Fetch](https://vivix.dev/api-calls)

## Technical details

- Stack: Svelte 5, Vite, TypeScript, Acorn AST, CodeMirror 6, GSAP, Web Worker interpreter
- Licence: MIT
- Source: https://github.com/HenryOnilude/vivix
- Live: https://vivix.dev

## Positioning

Python Tutor shows WHAT. Loupe shows WHEN. Vivix shows HOW.
